title: Club management – Kaderblick documentation

hero.heading: Club management
hero.lead: Manage members, club structure, fees, banking, documents and reports safely.

body:
Open the workspace and select a club

  1. Open Club management.
  2. Select the club at the top.
  3. Use Overview, Members, Organisation, Finance, Documents, Reports or Settings.

You only see clubs and functions permitted for your account.

Use the overview

  • Members: total and pending requests.
  • Organisation: departments, offices and committees.
  • Documents: generated club documents.
  • Reports: lists and key figures.
Important: Check the selected club before every change.

Create members and edit member records

Find a member

  1. Open Members.
  2. Search by name or member number.
  3. Filter by status if needed.
  4. Open the entry.

Read the member record

  • Master data: number, status, joining date, contact route and address.
  • Relations: linked user, player and coach records.
  • Organisation: departments, offices, committees, honours and qualifications.
  • Finance: contribution account, receivables and payments.
  • History: time-limited assignments and status changes.
  • Edit: master data, contacts, links and resignation.

Create a member

  1. Select Create member.
  2. Complete required fields.
  3. Check member number, joining date and address.
  4. Save.

A user link is not a membership. In Edit, open a linked account to maintain its club-management permissions.

Review applications and changes

Open Members → Review requests.

  • Membership applications: accept or reject a new membership.
  • Change requests: review data submitted through the member portal.
  • Link requests: connect a user account to an existing membership.

Make a decision

  1. Open the request.
  2. Compare it with existing members and links.
  3. Review warnings and evidence.
  4. Accept it or reject it with a clear reason.

A member record is created only after an application is accepted.

Import and check member data

Prepare the member file

  • Use one row per member and unique column headings.
  • Keep dates and numbers consistent within each column.
  • Remove sensitive information that is not required.

Run the import

  1. Open Members → Import data.
  2. Select or create a mapping profile.
  3. Upload the file.
  4. Map source columns to member fields.
  5. Review the preview, required-field errors and possible duplicates.
  6. Import only reviewed records.

Data quality

  1. Open Members → Data quality.
  2. Refresh the check.
  3. Open a finding and correct the member record.
  4. Run the check again.

Maintain the club structure

Open Organisation. The reference date shows the structure at a specific date.

  • Departments, offices and committees
  • Honour types and awards
  • Qualifications with validity periods
  • Anniversary rules based on membership duration

Maintain an assignment

  1. Create the required organisational item.
  2. Open the member record.
  3. Enter the assignment and its period.
  4. Mark the primary or contribution-relevant department if needed.
  5. Save and check the organisation view.

Manage fees, receivables and payments

Set up the basis

  1. Open Finance.
  2. Maintain contribution accounts and paying parties.
  3. Create contribution plans with validity periods.
  4. Assign members and required accounting codes.

Contribution run

  1. Select period, reference date and plan.
  2. Create a preview.
  3. Review items, discounts, exclusions and warnings.
  4. Obtain second approval where configured.
  5. Post the reviewed run.

Corrections

Posted operations are not overwritten. Use a credit, write-off, refund or reversal. Collection and dunning blocks stop the relevant action without deleting the receivable.

Run SEPA collection and bank matching

Before the first collection

  • Club bank account and creditor data are complete.
  • A valid mandate belongs to the correct paying party.
  • Pre-notification and execution date are checked.
  • Suspended, revoked or expired mandates are excluded.

Direct-debit run

  1. Open Finance → SEPA & Bank.
  2. Create a preview.
  3. Review exclusions and warnings.
  4. Obtain approval if required.
  5. Post the run and download the bank file.

Match transactions

  1. Import the supported bank file.
  2. Review suggested matches.
  3. Resolve unclear, split or combined payments.
  4. Post only after review.
  5. Record returned debits with the dedicated action.

An import alone does not create a posted payment.

Use documents and templates

Prepare a template

  1. Open Documents → Templates.
  2. Select document type and language.
  3. Edit content, placeholders and branding.
  4. Check the preview.
  5. Save a new version.

Create serial documents

  1. Open Serial documents.
  2. Select template and recipients.
  3. Review the preview and missing data.
  4. Start generation and check its status.

Use Search documents for generated files. Download personal data only when needed.

Create reports, lists and exports

Review figures

  1. Open Reports.
  2. Select the reporting date.
  3. Set joining and leaving periods.
  4. Open a status, gender, age, department or office group.

Save a list

  1. Enter a clear name.
  2. Select only required columns.
  3. Set filters.
  4. Choose whether authorised club managers may share it.
  5. Save.

Export

Check recipient, purpose and selected columns before CSV, spreadsheet or PDF exports. Where second approval is enabled, the file remains locked until approval.

Manage modules, custom fields and audit entries

Modules

Enable member management, contributions, SEPA and self-service under Settings → Modules. Dependent modules require their foundation.

Custom fields

  1. Open Custom fields.
  2. Set label, field type and validity.
  3. Choose whether it is required.
  4. Save and check a member record.

Audit log

Filter by period, action or object. The log explains changes; correct the underlying record instead of editing the log.

Second approval and club export

  • Define which finance or export operations need a second person.
  • Create a club-data export only for an authorised purpose and store it securely.
